title: BOS-855 session list — a live row's past-outcome hint goes recessive while an exempt hint stays bright, and the draft-PR failure survives the label change

scenes.title: a dimmed 'finalize failed' hint under a live 'working' row sits directly above the same text at full red under a non-live 'idle' row

steps.caption: Home session list loaded: the live row and its quiet twin are listed one above the other

expect.label: the live row's STATUS column reads 'working' (no row title contains the word, so this binds to the STATUS column)

steps.caption: The live row's composite is the present tense — 'working' — not the past-tense outcome below it

expect.label: the non-live twin is listed directly beneath the live row

steps.caption: The quiet row carries the SAME warning text, so the two intensities are one line apart

expect.label: the quiet row's STATUS column reads 'idle' — nothing is live there

steps.caption: Nothing is live on the quiet row, so its hint keeps the full danger colour

expect.label: the shared warning text appears as a hint sub-row under both rows — dimmed under the live one, full red under the idle one

steps.caption: Demote, never delete: the live row's 'finalize failed' hint is faded but still legible, while the idle row's identical hint stays at full danger intensity

scenes.title: the exemption — a stalled-agent hint impeaches the 'working' label, so it stays at full intensity beside the dimmed one

steps.caption: The stalled row sits in the same list as the dimmed one

expect.label: the stalled row's STATUS column also reads 'working'

steps.caption: Its composite claims the present tense just like the first row

expect.label: the stalled-agent hint renders at FULL danger intensity under that live row

steps.caption: This hint says the 'working' is a lie, so it is exempt — fading the one line that contradicts the label would be exactly backwards

scenes.title: the not-deleted case — a draft-PR failure that no longer owns the label still shows as a full-intensity hint sub-row

steps.caption: The session whose background draft-PR create failed while its chat kept working

expect.label: its STATUS column now reads the live 'working' label, no longer '? PR failed'

steps.caption: The live chat wins the primary label — the row no longer asserts a failure and a live chat at the same time

expect.label: the failure survives as a full-intensity hint sub-row rather than being lost with the label

steps.caption: The session is never transitioned, so the composite is never recolored — the hint is the row's only alarm and is therefore exempt from the recessive treatment
